en.hubeali:
From him, from Ismail Bin Mansour, from Al Mufazzal, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Whichever Muslim meets a Muslim, so he gladdens him, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would Gladden him’.
en.sarwar: 15. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from Isma’il ibn Mansur from al-Mufaddal from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Any Muslim who, on his meeting another Muslim, sends joy to his heart, Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, sends joy to his (initiator of joy) heart.”
